title: 第904章 一缕化身此方天道第903章 神祖陨落结局已定
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: 宁尘深吸一口气，接着没有丝毫犹豫，背后那一尊漆黑棺木化作死气消散，再度出现之时已然是浮现在天穹之上，死气凝实，化作一尊足以葬送诸神的棺木浮现。
当葬生之道尽数运转，死气落在寂灭神祖那尸身之上。
无数入葬气血自寂灭神祖身上浮现，皆是朝着葬神棺而去。
那些凝聚的入葬气血竟是在这时猛地一震，接着竟皆是一点点消散。
看到这一幕，宁尘眉头一皱，眼中闪过一抹凝重之色。
他的眼前，也是浮现出葬神棺那面板。
看到这一幕时，宁尘眼中闪过一抹凝重之色，当其感知之时却是完全从这寂灭神祖尸身之上感受不到任何的生机。
这家伙已是死的不能再死了。
可无论是自己，亦或是葬神棺，位格应该都在这寂灭神祖之上才对啊？
宁尘眉头紧皱，眼中满是深深的凝重。
当看到这一幕时，洛裳舞柳眉微蹙，也是看了过来。
洛苍等人也是看到了宁尘的动作，不由是愣了一下，眼中有些疑惑。
寂灭神祖这一尊大敌不是已被镇杀了么？
宁尘眼中闪过一抹凝重之色，当即是冲着洛裳舞轻喝一声，示意他们别过来。
content_en:
"Huh..."
Ning Chen took a deep breath, and then without any hesitation, the dark coffin behind him turned into death energy and dissipated. When it reappeared, it was already floating in the sky. The death energy solidified and turned into a coffin that could bury all the gods.
When all the ways to bury life were in motion, the energy of death fell on the corpse of the Ancestor of Annihilation.
Countless burial energy and blood emerged from the Ancestor of Nirvana, all heading towards the God Burial Coffin.
But suddenly.
Just then.
The condensed burial energy and blood suddenly shook at this moment, and then dissipated little by little.
"Huh?"
Seeing this scene, Ning Chen frowned and a solemn look flashed in his eyes.
at the same time.
In front of his eyes, the panel of the God Burial Coffin also appeared.
There are only four words on it.
【Cannot be buried. 】
"Can't be buried?"
"How is this possible?"
"Is it possible that this guy is not dead yet?"
When he saw this scene, a solemn look flashed in Ning Chen's eyes, but when he sensed it, he couldn't feel any life from the corpse of the Ancestor of Annihilation.
This guy is too dead to die.
Then why...can't be buried?
Is it because he is not qualified enough?
But whether it is himself or the God Burial Coffin, his status should be higher than that of the Ancestor of Annihilation, right?
Ning Chen frowned, his eyes filled with deep solemnity.
"Husband?"
When seeing this scene, Luo Shangwu frowned slightly and looked over.
"Huh?"
"What is Mr. Ning doing?"
And this time.
Luo Cang and others also saw Ning Chen's movements and couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, with some doubts in their eyes.
Hasn’t this great enemy, the Ancestor of Nirvana, been suppressed and killed?
"Madam, don't come here!"
"There is something wrong with this Ancestor of Annihilation."
A solemn look flashed in Ning Chen's eyes, and he immediately shouted at Luo Shangwu, signaling them not to come over.
"Huh?"
As soon as these words came out.
